about.label: About
about.title: About Me
about.intro: From boardrooms to classrooms — shaping confidence, one story at a time.

story.hook: I didn't originally plan to stay in teaching.
story.p1: When I first came to Vietnam, it was to volunteer and experience a different environment. The classroom was meant to be temporary. Over time, however, I began to appreciate the kind of responsibility teaching requires — patience, consistency, and showing up fully for students every day.
story.p2: What kept me here were the small moments of growth that happen quietly. A student speaking a little more confidently. Someone asking a thoughtful question. A child realising they can express an idea that once felt out of reach.
story.pull: From boardrooms to classrooms — shaping confidence, one story at a time.
story.p3: Working with them has reminded me how powerful curiosity and persistence can be. In many ways, they've influenced me as well — even introducing me to things like chess and the discipline that comes with learning it.
story.p4: Outside the classroom, I enjoy reading, training at the gym, and grappling. Those activities keep me grounded and remind me that improvement usually comes from steady effort over time rather than sudden breakthroughs.
story.p5: That mindset is something I try to bring into the classroom too — helping students become a little more confident, capable, and comfortable using English as they grow.
story.close: Teaching, for me, is simply about guiding that process — one student and one story at a time.

q1.question: Where are classes held?
q1.answer: Golden Mansion 1, 119 Phổ Quang, Phú Nhuận. I also teach at students' homes in Phú Nhuận, Gò Vấp, and Bình Thạnh.

q2.question: What ages do you teach?
q2.answer: Young Learners (6-10), Teens (11-17), and IELTS/exam prep for all ages.

q3.question: Do I need to commit long-term?
q3.answer: No contract. Month-to-month. Try for a month — see if it works for you.

q4.question: Do you teach only group classes?
q4.answer: Yes. All classes are group-based (max 10 students), including online sessions, so everyone gets speaking practice every session.

q5.question: What are your qualifications?
q5.answer: TESOL and PGCE certified. Taught at ILA Vietnam, BlueSky Kindergarten, and 15+ schools.

q6.question: Can I try a class first?
q6.answer: Yes. One free week of lessons. Bring your honest level — I'll tell you exactly where you stand.

q7.question: Why small groups instead of large classes?
q7.answer: In a 25-person class, you barely speak. With 10 students, you practice every session.

q8.question: Is your classroom safe for kids?
q8.answer: Yes. CCTV security, private restroom, air conditioning, and mosquito-killing lamps. Safe, comfortable, and parent-approved.
